'''Ash & Pikachu''' (Japanese: '''サトシとピカチュウ''' ''Satoshi and Pikachu'') is a [[Pokémon manga]] based directly on the [[Johto]] and some of the [[Hoenn]] seasons of {{aniseries|PTS}}. It is created by [[Takashi Teshirogi]].

All six volumes of the manga were translated into English by [[Chuang Yi]] in Singapore.

==Differences between the animated series and the manga==
This manga, while not having striking differences like ''[[The Electric Tale of Pikachu]]'', does put a few twists on certain episodes of {{aniseries|PTS}} by retelling it in a fun way. For example, the second chapter of the first volume combines the [[EP157|Pokémon fortune-telling episode]] and [[EP158|Ash's match]] against [[Whitney]], but with a couple of changes.

* [[Whitney]] is shown to have [[Whitney's grandmother|a grandmother]] living close to her in [[Goldenrod City]].
* During the [[Silver Conference]], [[Gary Oak]] uses a {{p|Nidoking}} instead of a {{p|Golem}}.

==Trivia==
* In the English translation by [[Chuang Yi]], many [[Character of the day|characters of the day]] from the animated series are referred to by their Japanese names and not the names that were used in the English dub.
